managed_trees.name: Brussels managed-tree register
managed_trees.credit: City of Brussels/Data Management; catalogue attributions: Bruxelles Mobilité, Bruxelles Environnement, Google Maps, Ville de Bruxelles/Espaces publics et verts
managed_trees.note: The prototype commits a 100-record feasibility snapshot.

managed_tree_crosswalk.name: Managed-tree identifier crosswalk
managed_tree_crosswalk.licence: Derived from CC BY 4.0 source records
managed_tree_crosswalk.note: Maps each committed managed-tree sample ID to the current live dataset identifier, matched within 2 m of the committed coordinates. The upstream catalogue re-keyed its primary key from numeric suffixes (for example vbx_56544) to UUIDs, so refreshes resolve the committed ID through this crosswalk. Regenerate with bin/generate_managed_tree_crosswalk.jl after an upstream re-key.

remarkable_trees.name: Brussels remarkable-tree register
remarkable_trees.credit: heritage.brussels; catalogue attribution: National Geographic Institute (NGI-IGN, ngi.be)
remarkable_trees.note: The prototype commits a 100-record feasibility snapshot.

heat.name: Urban heat islands — WBGT mean
heat.note: Heat-stress proxy, not a continuous air-temperature measurement. The authoritative metadata defines pixels as normalized 0–100 WBGT indicator values for 24 August 2016 and permits reuse under CC BY 4.0 with source attribution. The approximately 19 MB ZIP is not committed; heat-preview.png is a downsampled visual preview.

heat_wbgt.name: Daily maximum WBGT on 100 m UrbClim grid
heat_wbgt.type: daily gridded heat-stress model output, sampled at tree points
heat_wbgt.licence: Unresolved; source archive page states no licence
heat_wbgt.credit: VITO UrbClim; the archive page asks users to cite De Ridder et al. (2015), doi 10.1016/j.uclim.2015.01.001, and Souverijns et al. (2026), Data in Brief 65, 112497, doi 10.1016/j.dib.2026.112497
heat_wbgt.note: The archive publishes daily-maximum WBGT in °C, not the 0-100 indicator scale of the Brussels Environment 24-hour mean raster. Its page requests both citations but states no licence; derived values are exploratory and reuse terms must be confirmed with urbclim@vito.be before external reuse. NetCDF source files are cached locally and not committed.

heat_season.name: Seasonal heat context from ERA5 reanalysis
heat_season.type: daily reanalysis time series aggregated by season and grid cell
heat_season.credit: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (ERA5 reanalysis, ECMWF); retrieved through the Open-Meteo archive API.
heat_season.note: Daily apparent-temperature maxima and temperature minima provide multi-year temporal context. ERA5's 0.25-degree grid is about 28 km and cannot resolve intra-urban variation; this artifact contextualizes but does not replace the Brussels Environment WBGT raster in the ranking.

canopy.name: Urban Vegetation Data — Canopy Height Model
canopy.note: Useful canopy/vegetation layer, but the full shapefile is large and is not committed to this prototype.

road_accidents.name: Geolocation of road traffic accidents 2017–2024
road_accidents.type: geolocated injury and fatal road accidents
road_accidents.note: The committed extract contains 30,022 Brussels-region records; bicycle involvement is derived from the two road-user type fields. These are reported bodily-injury or fatal accidents, not all collisions or exposure-adjusted risk.

accident_context.name: Counter-level accident context
accident_context.licence: Derived from CC BY 4.0 and CC0 1.0 sources
accident_context.note: Counts all and bicycle-involved reported injury/fatal accidents within 250 m and 500 m of each bicycle counter; 26,335 of 30,022 records had usable coordinates. This is not exposure-adjusted risk.

mobility.name: Brussels bicycle counters
mobility.note: A mobility proxy. Counters are sparse and are not equivalent to general pedestrian street use.
